en.summary: The Liberal Democratic Party and Japan Innovation Party held their first meeting to discuss confidential childbirth, where mothers disclose their identity only to certain medical staff. The parties aim to align positions on child welfare rights and parental responsibility, with plans to compile recommendations by year-end.
